scripts/error_catalog_wheel_check.py

Python · Tier B

Verify installed diagnostics without source checkout imports or application dependencies.

Usage

Pass the built wheel path as the only argument.

Inputs

An already-built wheel; no network, installer or environment activation.

Side effects

Extracts the wheel into an automatically removed temporary directory.

Cleanup

The child runs with isolated Python and no site packages.

@see src/error_catalog/registry.py
